brief:
Settlers attacked the Al-Masoudiyeh area north of Nablus early Tuesday morning, leaving a Palestinian man and his son injured with wounds and bruises, Shehab Wire reported. The targeted location sits on land belonging to Barqa village in the northwestern sector of the city, in the occupied West Bank.

Local sources said a group of settlers carried out the assault on the two Palestinians. The incident marked the latest in a series of settler attacks on Palestinian communities in the northern West Bank region, an area that has experienced repeated violence in recent months.
